load_vertex_ai_credentials: load Vertex AI service account credentials from environment variables and a JSON key file into a temporary file
test_vertex_load: run an async load test that compares text-only versus text-plus-image message performance against Vertex AI Gemini
make_async_calls: execute batches of async litellm completion calls and measure total elapsed time for text or image messages
create_async_task: create an async task that calls litellm.acompletion with a Vertex AI Gemini model and text or image messages
run_vertex_load_test: run the Vertex AI load test suite to benchmark performance differences between text-only and multimodal image requests
